description: This file defines data structures, enums, macros, and function prototypes for handling expressions, symbols, properties, and menus in a configuration system, likely related to kernel or software configuration management.

classes.name: file
classes.description: Represents a file with name, parent, and next file in list.

classes.name: tristate
classes.description: Enumeration for tristate values: no, mod, yes.

classes.name: expr_type
classes.description: Enumeration for expression types such as E_NONE, E_OR, E_AND, etc.

classes.name: expr_data
classes.description: Union holding either an expression pointer or a symbol pointer.

classes.name: expr
classes.description: Represents an expression with a type and left/right data.

classes.name: expr_value
classes.description: Holds an expression and its evaluated tristate value.

classes.name: symbol_value
classes.description: Holds a value pointer and tristate for a symbol.

classes.name: symbol_type
classes.description: Enumeration for symbol types: unknown, boolean, tristate, int, hex, string.

classes.name: symbol
classes.description: Represents a configuration symbol with properties, dependencies, and flags.

classes.name: prop_type
classes.description: Enumeration for property types such as prompt, comment, menu, default, etc.

classes.name: property
classes.description: Represents a property associated with a symbol, including type, text, visibility, and source file info.

classes.name: menu
classes.description: Represents a menu node in the configuration UI, with links to parent, children, symbol, properties, dependencies, and flags.

classes.name: jump_key
classes.description: Represents a jump key in menu navigation, with list entries, offset, and target menu.

methods.name: expr_alloc_symbol
methods.description: Allocates an expression for a symbol.

methods.name: expr_alloc_one
methods.description: Allocates an expression of a given type with one subexpression.

methods.name: expr_alloc_two
methods.description: Allocates an expression of a given type with two subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_comp
methods.description: Allocates a comparison expression between two symbols.

methods.name: expr_alloc_and
methods.description: Creates an AND expression from two expressions.

methods.name: expr_alloc_or
methods.description: Creates an OR expression from two expressions.

methods.name: expr_copy
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of an expression.

methods.name: expr_free
methods.description: Frees memory associated with an expression.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_eq
methods.description: Eliminates equality expressions.

methods.name: expr_eq
methods.description: Checks if two expressions are equal.

methods.name: expr_calc_value
methods.description: Calculates the tristate value of an expression.

methods.name: expr_trans_bool
methods.description: Transforms an expression into a boolean form.

methods.name: expr_eliminate_dups
methods.description: Eliminates duplicate subexpressions.

methods.name: expr_transform
methods.description: Transforms an expression, possibly simplifying.

methods.name: expr_contains_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression contains a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_depends_symbol
methods.description: Checks if an expression depends on a specific symbol.

methods.name: expr_trans_compare
methods.description: Transforms comparison expressions involving symbols.

methods.name: expr_fprint
methods.description: Prints an expression to a file.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print
methods.description: Prints an expression to a gstr object.

methods.name: expr_gstr_print_revdep
methods.description: Prints reverse dependencies of an expression.

methods.name: expr_is_yes
methods.description: Checks if an expression evaluates to 'yes'.

methods.name: expr_is_no
methods.description: Checks if an expression evaluates to 'no'.
